title: The same rollout memo with its benchmark supplied (the 38% recomputes) and a recommendation sized to what the pilot measured (clean control)

proof.python:
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('bench/pilot_p95.csv')))
b = sum(int(r['p95_before_ms']) for r in rows) / 3
a = sum(int(r['p95_after_ms']) for r in rows) / 3
assert (b, a) == (410.0, 254.0) and round((b - a) / b * 100) == 38
assert 3 * 1400 == 4200 and 9 * 1400 == 12600 and 6 * 1400 == 8400 and 'Regions served by the company: 9' in open('pricing.md').read()
